items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A gentle leave-on cream that helps with the look of uneven tone and visible blemishes.
A light barrier moisturizer to support comfort, since the scan shows lower moisture.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection that suits pregnancy-conscious routines.

response.routine_note: Because your breakouts feel severe and you are pregnant, please ask your OB or a dermatologist about benzoyl peroxide before using any, so I have left it out rather than choosing the strongest one. Cleanse morning and night, apply the azelaic cream at night then moisturizer, and finish your morning with the mineral SPF.
